example.unknown.en: This app has no example with that name.
example.unknown.de: Diese App hat kein Beispiel mit diesem Namen.

example.undecodable.en: The example could not be read: its file is outdated or damaged.
example.undecodable.de: Das Beispiel konnte nicht gelesen werden: Seine Datei ist veraltet oder beschädigt.

example.empty.en: The example file is empty, so nothing was loaded.
example.empty.de: Die Beispieldatei ist leer, daher wurde nichts geladen.

cases.name: the empty id seats the app's own genesis document
the empty id never decodes an asset
a declared example that decodes seats that example
an undeclared id is refused as unknown
an undeclared id is refused before anything decodes
ids are exact, never case-folded or trimmed
a declared example whose asset does not decode is refused as undecodable
a declared example whose asset decodes to the genesis document is refused as empty
